Italian Garden Soup Mix

A ten-ingredient pantry mix built for a slow simmer: red kidney beans, chickpeas, red lentils, green split peas and small shell pasta, layered with dried oregano, basil, thyme, parsley and rosemary. No fillers, no flavour packets — just what's on the label.

Net Weight350 g (12 oz)
ContainsWheat
Shelf-StablePantry mix, no fridge needed

Ingredients: Red kidney beans, chickpeas, red lentils, green split peas, small shell pasta (wheat), dried oregano, dried basil, dried thyme, dried parsley, dried rosemary.

New blends are in development. Have a flavour you'd love to see on a Sudbury pantry shelf?

How to Make It

Serves 4–6
  • 1 pouch Italian Garden Soup Mix
  • 2 L (8 cups) water or broth
  • Salt & pepper, to taste
  • Olive oil, to finish
  • Crusty bread, to serve
  1. Empty the entire pouch into a large pot.
  2. Add 2 L (8 cups) of water or broth.
  3. Bring to a boil over medium-high heat.
  4. Reduce heat, cover, and simmer 45–50 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the beans and lentils are tender.
  5. Season with salt, pepper, and a drizzle of olive oil to taste.
  6. Serve hot with crusty bread.

Our Story

Prism Meals & Co. started with a simple idea: pantry food shouldn't mean choosing between convenience and real ingredients. Founded in 2026 by two friends in Sudbury, Ontario, we pack every soup mix by hand, in small batches, with ingredients we're genuinely glad to put our name on.

We're food-handler certified and building this the careful way — one product done right before the next one joins it. Italian Garden Soup Mix is where we're starting. Meal-prep bundles and small-batch catering are next, built on the same idea: honest food, without the shortcuts.

Everything is packed, sealed, and labelled right here in Sudbury — nothing outsourced, nothing mass-produced.
